paper.title: Distribution-Free Two-Sample Tests for Scale
paper.journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.access_boundary: Publisher metadata and abstract were read through the indexed publisher record. Direct scripted retrieval returned HTTP 403; no complete-paper body read, derivation reconstruction, or paper-file hash is claimed.

bounded_read.source_scope_read: scipy.stats.fligner implementation and its immediately associated documentation
verified_claims: the median is the default within-sample center
each sample is transformed to absolute deviations from its own center
each rank is transformed by Phi^-1(rank/(2*(N+1))+0.5)
the statistic divides the weighted between-group normal-score dispersion by the pooled sample variance of the scores
the returned null comparison is chi-square with k-1 degrees of freedom

claim_boundary: The records support a distribution-free scale-method identity and exact implementation arithmetic only. They do not test WTI, fixed six-by-six monthly blocks, recent-only scale direction, cumulative-return continuation, CFDs, fixed risk, activity, or performance.
